name: Lau bo
summary: Lẩu bò is beef hotpot, cooked at the table and shared. In Da Nang it is a dinner for a longer stay, in the same company as bún chả cá, nem lụi, and bê thui.
howToEat: Order the hotpot for the table when you are staying longer than one lunch.
where: Da Nang, without one door to name.
seoTitle: Lau bo — beef hotpot in Da Nang
seoDescription: Lẩu bò is beef hotpot, a Da Nang dinner for a longer stay, in the company of bún chả cá, nem lụi, and bê thui.
